messages:
Marissa Cole: kicking off the usage insights workstream here. goal today: lock PRD scope + GA criteria + who we want as beta/design partners. dropping agenda doc in a sec.

Paula Mendes: :wave: thanks. PRD draft is ~80% there but want to align on (1) what ships in v1 vs post-GA and (2) success metrics that are actually measurable.

Talia Benson: I can keep notes + action items. also we should decide if we’re calling this “usage insights” vs “cost drivers” in console nav.

Tessa Morgan: +1 on naming. design started with “Cost drivers” because it maps to the mental model, but we can use “Usage insights” as umbrella.

Logan Wright: telemetry side: biggest early decision is route definition + normalization + cardinality enforcement. if we don’t pin that this week, pipeline work gets messy.

Marissa Cole: ok. here’s the PRD link (WIP): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/usage-insights-prd (pls comment inline). today I’d like: scope bullet list + GA gates.

Paula Mendes: quick summary of proposed v1 scope:
- route + model dimensions in metering
- console route list (top spend) + route detail (model breakdown + what changed)
- exports: CSV + JSON with audit log
non-goals: anomaly alerts, custom dims

Dylan Brooks: console team can do route list + route detail + export entrypoint behind ff. question is how deep “what changed” goes. if it’s just prior period delta, doable.

Tessa Morgan: from design: I’m assuming “what changed” is delta in cost + tokens + p95 latency, with top contributing models. NOT a full root-cause UI.

Paula Mendes: yup. plus callouts like “data may lag by up to X” and “unknown route”.

Allison Grant: SRE ask: GA criteria must include data freshness SLO + dashboards in place + cardinality alarms. otherwise we’ll get paged into oblivion.

Logan Wright: +1. we can commit to:
- ingestion to aggregates within 15m p95 (aspirational)
- insights API p95 latency < 800ms for top routes query at normal load
- export job success rate target
but need to confirm feasibility.

Nadia Rahman: cost attribution specifics: do we want cached tokens broken out in v1? it’s a big driver for “why invoice != console” confusion.

Paula Mendes: PRD currently includes input/output/cached tokens + unit cost. does everyone agree it’s v1 requirement?

Dev Patel: support POV: please yes. otherwise every ticket becomes “why is my cost high” and we can’t point to caching/route breakdown. also need the canned explanation about invoice reconciliation.

Alex Martinez: DevEx: we need crisp “how to set route identifiers” across SDKs + gateway. if route tagging is optional, unknown route will dominate. docs/SDK work should be part of GA gate imo.

Marissa Cole: ok let’s talk GA gates. proposing:
1) route + model dimensions end-to-end (telemetry -> aggregates -> API -> UI)
2) exports with audit logging + RBAC checks
3) cardinality controls in place + documented best practices
4) basic ops dashboards (pipeline lag, export failures, API errors)
5) docs page + SDK examples shipped
anything missing?

Chloe Martin: add “query cost budget” / guardrails. top routes query can get expensive quickly with filters + long windows.

Logan Wright: yes. we can enforce max time range + pagination + pre-aggregations (hourly/daily). but that’s part of scope decision: hourly rollups in v1?

Paula Mendes: PRD says hourly + daily. but we could ship daily only first if needed.

Dylan Brooks: UI wants at least 24h / 7d / 30d views. daily rollup works for 7d/30d but 24h needs hourly-ish or it looks jagged.

Tessa Morgan: also “sparklines” in route list look broken if we only have daily for 24h.

Nadia Rahman: hourly aggregation also helps explain “what changed week-over-week” with fewer artifacts. I’d push for hourly in v1, but with retention shorter.

Allison Grant: if hourly is included, we need explicit freshness expectations + how late arriving token metering is handled. otherwise customers will see numbers moving.

Logan Wright: we can message “last 1–2 hours may shift” and compute on watermark. but we should decide whether the UI uses a ‘finalized’ window.

Paula Mendes: ok, capturing: hourly + daily stay in scope, but we’ll include ‘data completeness’ messaging + watermark logic.

Marissa Cole: beta customers: Markus, can you share who’s lined up?

Markus Klein: current candidates based on interest:
- mid-market SaaS (FinOps team) asking for chargeback by route
- enterprise Dedicated prospect asking for model-level spend by internal service
- existing hosted customer with weekly CSV export workflow
I can DM names; for thread: we want 5–8 design partners total.

Dev Patel: support wants at least 1 customer who’s already filing invoice mismatch tickets. they’ll validate the FAQ + exports.

Alex Martinez: +1 and at least 1 who uses multiple SDKs (python + ts) so we can catch route tagging inconsistencies.

Paula Mendes: beta entry criteria proposal:
- customer willing to tag routes (or uses gateway)
- agrees to weekly feedback check-in
- ok with “beta” label + data freshness caveats

Tessa Morgan: also need beta feedback structured. I’ll add a simple rubric: can they answer “what routes cost most” in <2 min + can they export and use it.

Talia Benson: action item: Markus to propose beta list + owners by EOW.

Logan Wright: open question for PRD: when model fallback happens mid-request (smart routing), do we attribute cost to original route + actual model used. yes, but that means event schema includes both requested_model + served_model.

Paula Mendes: PRD currently says breakdown by “model variant” and mentions fallback. I’ll add explicit requirement: expose served model for spend attribution + keep route stable.

Chloe Martin: UI copy should avoid confusion: “Requested model” vs “Billed model” maybe. otherwise users think we swapped their config.

Tessa Morgan: I’ll mock options. prefer “Model used” in breakdown + tooltip “may differ due to fallback”.

Allison Grant: GA gate: alerting thresholds defined. at least:
- pipeline lag > 30m for 15m
- export failure rate > 5% over 1h
- insights API 5xx > 1% over 10m

Marissa Cole: agree. and we should gate GA behind feature flag + staged rollout.

Dylan Brooks: console plan: ff per org. start with internal dogfood + beta orgs. roll out gradually.

Alex Martinez: docs deliverables: need 1 page “Tagging routes” with naming rules + “Usage insights overview” + “Export schema + limits”. I’ll sync with Elliot/Wei but we need eng to provide screenshots.

Paula Mendes: success metrics (PRD):
- 30% of active orgs with route tagging enabled within 30 days of GA
- 50% of orgs viewing insights page weekly (beta) / 20% (GA)
- support tickets about “where is my spend going” decrease (hard to measure)
- export usage by finance/ops personas
thoughts?

Dev Patel: ticket metric is noisy. maybe measure time-to-resolution for cost attribution tickets, or “deflected” via docs.

Allison Grant: also an internal metric: p95 dashboard data latency. that’s the one we’ll care about day 2.

Logan Wright: for eng: we need a concrete SLA for analytics API; if we’re promising “near real time” we need numbers.

Marissa Cole: let’s set customer-facing promise as “updates within ~30 minutes” for GA, even if backend is faster. keep us safe.

Paula Mendes: works. I’ll update PRD wording to “typically within 15–30m; may be delayed during incidents.”

Talia Benson: recap action items:
- Paula: update PRD w/ GA gates, hourly+dailies, fallback attribution wording, customer-facing freshness promise
- Tessa: draft IA naming + ‘model used’ tooltip copy, and beta usability rubric
- Logan/Nadia: confirm feasibility of hourly aggregates + watermark strategy; propose SLOs + query cost budgets
- Allison: draft alert thresholds + dashboard requirements as GA gate
- Markus: propose beta customer list + internal owners
- Alex: outline docs pages + screenshot asks

Marissa Cole: :thumbsup: thanks all. please add PRD comments by tomorrow noon so we can lock scope before eng sprint planning.

Paula Mendes: will do. I’ll ping when PRD updated.

Dylan Brooks: also can we align on “route” naming conventions in PRD? otherwise console will show garbage.

Logan Wright: yes. I’ll paste the initial rules in PRD today (length limit, allowed chars, no IDs). we’ll formalize in ADR next.

Allison Grant: + reminder: cardinality alarms need ownership. please assign a DRI in eng.

Marissa Cole: Logan can you own that (with Thomas)?

Logan Wright: yep, I’ll take it. will loop Thomas.

Talia Benson: marking thread as “kickoff complete” once PRD update lands. keep follow-ups here.
